name: RAG (retrieval-augmented generation)
description: The default in-process RAG capability: embeds text (via the engines embed sidecar) and serves vector retrieval. A GraphRAG or third-party RAG provider app can bind the `rag` capability to swap the implementation.

permission_levels.label: Can search
permission_levels.description: Search indexed Space content and receive retrieved passages as context.

permission_levels.label: Can index
permission_levels.description: Add content to the retrieval index, which becomes trusted context for everyone on the node.
